codes.display: Indicates a conflict between the administration date in RXA-3 and the expiration date in RXA-16. In other words it indicates that an expired vaccine was administered.
codes.comments: Conflicting Administration Date and Expiration Date. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of dates (and recall patient if necessary).

codes.display: Indicates that if an ID and an alternate ID are messaged in the same field, that the receiving system has mapped those two codes to different, non-homologous concepts.
codes.comments: Conflicting Codes in a Field. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration or mapping tables.

codes.display: Indicates that the observation method for patient eligibility is invalid
codes.comments: Invalid Observation Method. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration.

codes.display: Indicates that the lot number messaged in RXA-15 couldn't be linked to a lot.
codes.comments: Lot Not Found. Clinical team should review patient and/or lot records to confirm accuracy of the lot numbers.

codes.display: Indicates that the VIS given date was not messaged.
codes.comments: Missing VIS Given Date. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the VIS data.

codes.display: Indicates that data was sent in an unsupported field. While OK to raise an error, this probably should not prevent processing of the message.
codes.comments: Unsupported Field Populated. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration.

codes.display: Indicates that the profile in MSH-21 does not match the query in QPD-1.
codes.comments: Conflicting Query Identifiers. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration.

codes.display: Indicates that the administration amount is inconsistent with the vaccine administered
codes.comments: Conflicting Vaccine and Amount Data. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the dose data.

codes.display: Indicates that the administration route is inconsistent with the vaccine administered
codes.comments: Conflicting Vaccine and Route Data. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the dose data.

codes.display: Indicates that a contraindication effective date messaged in OBX-5 is in the future
codes.comments: Future Contraindication Effective Date. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the dose data.

codes.display: Used when multiple IDs are messaged in PID-3 to indicate that the individual IDs are associated with different patient records in the IIS.
codes.comments: Conflicting Patient IDs. MPI team should review patient records with IIS MPI expert to identify records to merge/unmerge.

codes.display: Indicates that an add message was received for existing dose or update message was received for a new dose
codes.comments: Action Code Mismatch. Clinical team should review patient immunization history with IIS to identify missing doses.

codes.display: Indicates that for a particular observation ID (OBX-3), an invalid value set was used in OBX-5
codes.comments: Invalid Value Set. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration.

codes.display: Indicates that the VIS publication date was not messaged.
codes.comments: Missing VIS Publication Date. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the VIS data.

codes.display: Indicates that no matching patient was found using the data in the message but that the receiving system created a new patient record.
codes.comments: No matching patient found, new patient record was created. Clinical team: typically, no action is required.

codes.display: Indicates that the administration site is inconsistent with the vaccine administered
codes.comments: Conflicting Vaccine and Site Data. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the dose data.

codes.display: Indicates that patient eligibility data should not be sent for historical doses
codes.comments: Conflicting Dose Status and Eligibility. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the eligibility data.

codes.display: Indicates that the administration being reported occurred too far in the past.
codes.comments: Vaccination Date Too Long Ago. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the dose data.

codes.display: Indicates that an invalid comment was received. Comments should be clinically relevant and should not include data that can be sent discretely elsewhere in the message.
codes.comments: Invalid Comment. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration.

codes.display: Indicates that no matching patient was found using the data in the message. Action must be taken to establish a patient record before immunization data can be submitted (e.g., the patient must consent to be in the registry).
codes.comments: No matching patient found, please establish patient record first. MPI team should investigate why the patient record is not in the receiving system and create the patient record if appropriate.

codes.display: Indicates that the patient found is too old.
codes.comments: Patient Too Old. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration.

codes.display: The value is not valid. This applies for fields that are not associated with a table of values.
codes.comments: Invalid value. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration or database contents.

codes.display: Indicates a conflict between PID-29 and PID-30 or between PD1-16 and either PID field. In other words, one element indicates the patient is deceased and another element indicates the patient is not deceased.
codes.comments: Conflicting Patient Status and Patient Death Information. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of patient status and/or dates.

codes.display: Indicates that the patient parent/guardian/responsible person was not messaged.
codes.comments: Missing Parent/Guardian/Responsible Person. Clinical or Registration team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the next of kin data.

codes.display: Indicates that the coded value is not found in the associated table.
codes.comments: Table value not found, a code mapping error. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration or mapping tables.

codes.display: Indicates that any date field is in the future. Specific errors for date transmitted in an OBX are also provided.
codes.comments: Future Date. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the dose data.

codes.display: Indicates that eligibility data was messaged in the PV1 segment rather than in an OBX segment.
codes.comments: Eligibility in PV1. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration.

codes.display: Indicates that the dates in RXA-3 and RXA-4 are not identical.
codes.comments: Conflicting Start and End Date of Administration. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration or database contents.

codes.display: The value conflicts with other data in the message
codes.comments: Illogical Value error. Not recommended for use; use a more granular application error instead. No actor or action applies.

codes.display: Date conflicts with another date in the message.
codes.comments: Illogical Date error. Not recommended for use; use a more granular application error instead. No actor or action applies.

codes.display: Indicates that the facilities in MSH-4, MSH-11, ORC-17 and/or RXA-11 do not match
codes.comments: Conflicting Facilities. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration or database contents.

codes.display: This error would be applied at the application level and may be used when data is sent but could not be interpreted.
codes.comments: Required Data Missing, an application-level error. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration or mapping tables.

codes.display: Indicates that either a refusal reason was messaged in RXA-18 when the completion status in RXA-20 was not RE or a valid refusal reason was not messaged when the completion status was RE.
codes.comments: Conflicting Completion Status and Refusal Reason. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the dose status.

codes.display: Indicates that an unrecognized or unsupported profile identifier is being used.
codes.comments: Unknown Profile ID. Interface Analyst should review interface configuration.

codes.display: Indicates that the patient found has requested protection of their data.
codes.comments: Protected Patient Found. Clinical team should discuss the importance of data sharing with the patient.

codes.display: Indicates that the funding source code in an OBX segment conflicts with other data in the message (eligibility, age etc)
codes.comments: Conflicting Funding Source Data. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the funding data.

codes.display: Indicates that the record indicated by the message cannot be deleted via an HL7 message
codes.comments: Interface Cannot Delete. Clinical team should review patient immunization history with IIS.

codes.display: Indicates that a patient name was received that indicates that a temporary baby name was messaged.
codes.comments: Invalid Name (Baby). Clinical or Registration team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the patient data; message may need to be retriggered after a legal name is documented.

codes.display: Indicates that a VIS given date messaged in OBX-5 is in the future
codes.comments: Future VIS Given Date. Clinical team should review patient record to confirm accuracy of the dose data.
